m: अ-साधारण mf(ई)n. not common, special, specifical, Tarkas.
quite uncommon, extraordinary, Daś.; Kathās. &c.
अ-साधारण n. special property, L.
a: असाधारण — a. 1 Not common, peculiar, special, specific. --2 (In logic) Existing neither in सपक्ष or विपक्ष as a hetu; यस्तूभयस्माद् व्यावृत्तः स त्वसाधारणो मतः. --3 Not to be claimed by any one else, exclusively belonging to one (as wealth &c.); पिता पुत्रांतरेष्वपि साधारणो माता त्वसाधारणी Mit. --णः A fallacy or हेत्वाभास in Logic; one of the three kinds of अनैकांतिक q. v. --णं Speciality, special property.

m: अ-साधारणोपमा f. a kind of comparison (in which a person or thing is said to be only comparable to himself or itself?), Kāvyād. ii, 37.

a: असाधनीय, असाध्य — a. 1 Not to be accomplished or completed, not proper, easy, or capable of being accomplished; नास्ति असाध्यं नाम मनोभुवः K. 157. --2 Not capable of being proved. --3 Incurable, irremediable (as a disease or patient); असाध्यः कुरुते कोपं प्राप्ते काले गदो यथा Śi. 2. 84; असाध्य इति वैद्येनातुर इव V. 3; Mv. 4. 23; भिषजामसाध्यं R. 8. 93.

m: अ-साधन mfn. without means, destitute of resources or materials or instruments or implements, MBh. &c.
अ-साधन n. not a means, anything not effective of an object, Kap.
a: असाधन — a. Without means, destitute of resources, materials, or instruments; Pt. 2. 1. --नं 1 Non-accomplishment. --2 Not proving or establishing.

m: अ-साधु mfn. (Pāṇ. vi, 2, 160) not good, wicked, bad, ŚBr.; MBh. &c.
wrong Comm. on TPrāt.
(in rhet.) not grammatically correct (as अन्य-कारक for अन्यत्-क्˚), Vām. ii, 1, 5.
अ-साधु (उस्), m. not an honest man, a wicked man, ŚBr.; Mn. &c.
अ-साधु (उ), n. anything bad, evil, ŚBr. (साध्वसाधुनी, ‘good and evil’), MBh. &c.
disfavour, disgrace, only (˚उना instr. ind.) disfavourably, ŚBr. ii; ChUp. (cf. 3. अ-सामन्)
अ-साधु (उ), ind. (used as an interjection of disapproval) bad! shame! Rājat. &c.
a: असाधु — a. 1 Not good, bad, distasteful, unpleasant; अतोर्हसि क्षंतुमसाधु साधु वा Ki. 1. 4. --2 Wicked. --3 Illbehaved (with loc.); असाधुर्मातरि Sk. --4 Corrupt, not properly formed or Sanskrit (as a word). --ध्वी An unchaste woman. ˚ता, --त्वं Wickedness. --Comp. --वृत्ता an unchaste woman.

m: अ-साधुना ind., instr., disfavourably, ŚBr. ii; ChUp. (cf. 3. अ-सामन्)
अ-साधु—त्व n. wickedness, Kām. &c.
the not being approvable, VarBṛS.
अ-साधु—वाद m. disapproval, BhP.
अ-साधु—वृत्त mf(आ)n. having bad manners, Mn. ix, 80.

m: अ-साध्य mfn. not to be effected or completed, not proper or able to be accomplished, Yājñ. ii, 196; Hariv. &c.
incurable, irremediable, MBh. iv, 395; Suśr. &c.
not to be overpowered or mastered, Pañcat.; Kām.
not susceptible of proof Comm. on Yājñ. ii, 6.
अ-साध्य—ता f. incurableness, Suśr.
the state of one not to be mastered, Pañcat.
अ-साध्य—त्व n. incurableness, Suśr.
अ-सांनिध्य n. ‘non-nearness’, absence, MBh. iii, 610; R.; Śak.
अ-सांप्रदायिक mfn. not traditional, not sanctioned by tradition, Uttarar. Comm. on Mn. iii, 127, &c.
अ-सांप्रत mfn. not becoming, improper, MBh. i, 6371, &c.
unseasonable, Daś.
not belonging to the present time (as Brahman), MārkP.
a: असांप्रत — a. Unfit, unbecoming, improper; अनाचक्षाणयाऽसांप्रतं कृतं M. 5. --तं ind. Improperly, unfitly; oft. used with an adjectival force = असांप्रत; विषवृक्षोऽपि संवर्ध्य स्वयं छेत्तुमसांप्रतं Ku. 2. 55; संप्रत्यसांप्रतं वक्तुमुक्ते मुसलपाणिना Śi. 2. 71. R. 8. 61; Pt. 1. 245.

m: अ-सांप्रतम् ind. unfitly, improperly, MBh. v, 3255, &c.
अ-सांप्रतिक-ता f. improper behaviour, Bālar.
अ-सांतापिक mfn., Pāṇ. vi, 2, 155, Sch.
अ-साद mfn. not mounted on horseback, AV. xi, 10, 24
not becoming tired, unwearied, Rājat.
a: असाद — a. Ved. Not sitting; having no seat.

। “SrotriyAstApasA vfdDA ye ca prabrajitAdayaH । asAkziRaste vacanAnnAtra heturudAhftaH” yA॰ smf॰ tApasAvAnaprasTAH । AdiSabdena pitrAvivadamAnAdInAM grahaRam । yaTAha SaNKaH । “na pitrAvivadamAnagurukulavAsiparivrAjakavAna prasTanirgranTayaH sAsiRa” iti dozAdasAkziRo darSitA nAradena “stenAH sAhasikAScaRqAH kitavA vaYcakAstaTA । asAkziRaste duzwatvAttezu satyanna vidyata” iti । caRqAHkopanAH kitavAdyUtakftaH । BedAdasAkziRAYca svarUpantenEva darSitam । “sAkziRAM liKitAnAM ca nirdizwAnAYca vAdinA । tezAmeko'nyaTA vAdI BedAtsarve na sAkziRa” iti । taTA svayamuktisvarUpaYcoktam । “svayamuktiranirddizwaH svayamevetya yo vadet । sUcItyuktaH saSAstrezu na sa sAkzitvamarha tIti” । mftAntarasyApi laRaRamuktam । “yo'rTaH SrAvayitavyaH syAttasminnasati cArTini । kva tadvadatu sAkzitva mityasAkzI mftAntara” iti । yenArTinA pratyarTinA vA sAkziRAM yo'rTaH SrAvayitavyo Bavet yUyamatrArTe sAkziRa iti । tasminnarTini pratyarTini vA asati mfte'rTe ca anivedite sAkzI kva kasminnarTe kasya vA kfte sAkzyaM vadatviti mftAntaraH sAkzI na Bavati yatra tu mumUrzuRA svasTena vA pitrA putrAdayaH SrAvitAH asminnarTe amI sAkziRa iti । tatra mftAntaropi sAkzI । yaTAha nAradaH । “mftAntaro'rTini prete mumUrzuSrAvitAdfte” । taTA । “SrAvitonAtureRApi yastvarTo DarmasaMhitaH । mfte'pi tatra sAkzI syAt zawsu cAnvAhitAdizu” । tAnetAnasAkziRo darSayati । “strIbAlavfdDakitavamattonmattABiSastakAH” । raNgAvatAripAzaRqikUwakfdvikalendriyAH । patitAptArTasambanDisahAyariputaskarAH । sAhasI dfzwadozaSca nirdDUtAdyAstvasAkziRaH” । strI prasidDA । vAlo'prAptavyavahAraH । vfdDo'SItikAvaraH bfdDvagrahaRaM vacananizidDA nAmanyezAmapi SrotriyAdInAmupalakzaRam । kitavo'kzadevI । mattaH pAnAdinA, unmatto grahAvizwaH । aBiSastaH, aBiyukto brahmahatyAdinA । raNgAvatArI cAraRaH pAzaRqino nirgranTipraBftayaH । kUwakft kapawaleKyAdikArI vikalendriyaH SrotrAdirahitaH patitaH brahmahAdiH । AptaH suhft, arTasambanDI vipratipadyamAnArTasambanDI । sahAya ekakAryyaH ripuH SatruH taskaraH stenaH sAhasI svabalAvazwamBakArI dfzwadozo dfzwavitaTa vacanaH । nirDUto banDuBistyaktaH । AdiSabdAdanyezAmapi smftyantaroktAnAM dozAdasAkziRAmBedAdasAkziRAM svayanuktermftAntarasya ca grahaRam । ete strIbAlAdayaH sAkziRo na Bavanti” mitA॰ । atrApavAdaH “sarvvaH sAkzI saMgrahaRe cOryye pAruzyasAhase” । yA॰ smf॰ saMgrahaRAdO sarvve vacananizidDAH SrotriyAdayaH tapaHpraBfti guRarahitASca sAkziRoBavanti। dozAdasAkziRo BedAdasAkziRaH svayamuktiScAtrApi sAkziRo na Bavanti satyABAvAdihetostezu vidyamAnatvAditi” mitA॰ ।
m: अ-साक्षिन् mfn. incompetent as a witness, not an eye-witness, Yājñ. ii, 71; Viṣṇus.
a: असाक्षिन् — a. 1 Not an eye-witness. --2 One whose evidence is not admissible (in law). --3 One who is disqualified to attest a legal document.

अ-साक्ष्य n. want of evidence.
असालति-प्रकाश m. N. of a dictionary (written under Asālati, king of Kaśmīr).

a: असार — a. [न. ब.] 1 Sapless, insipid. --2 (a) Without essence, useless; असारः खलु संसारः Udb.; (b) worthless, unsubstantial, without strength, stuff or value, deprived of its essence; असारं संसारं परिमुषितरत्नं त्रिभुवनं Māl. 5. 30; U. 1; असारे खलु संसारे सारमेतच्चतुष्टयं Dharm. 12, 13; Bh. 3. 146. --3 Vain, unprofitable; Pt. 1. 28. --4 Weak, feeble, infirm, fragile; श्रुतिपथमसारं Mu. 6. 14; बहूनामप्यसाराणां संहतिः कार्यसाधिका ( समवायो हि दुर्जयः) Pt. 1. 331; Śi. 2. 50. --5 Poor; Dk. 40. --रः, --रं 1 Unessential or unimportant portion; कुर्यादसारभंगो हि सारभंगमपि स्फुटं H. 3. 89. --2 N. of a tree (एरंड). --3 Aloe wood.

k.v: निर्णिक्तं शोधितं मृष्टं निःशोध्यमनवस्करम्. अवसारं फल्गु शून्यं तु वशिकं तुच्छरिक्तके॥

m: अ-सार—ता f. saplessness, unfitness, worthlessness, fragility, Yājñ. ii, 60; Ragh. viii, 50.
a: असारता — 1 Saplessness. --2 Worthlessness; Y. 2. 60. --3 Unsubstantial nature; transitory or frail state; धिगिमां देहभृतामसारतां R. 8. 51.

m: अ-सात्म्य mfn. unwholesome, disagreeing (as food), Car.; Suśr.
अ-सावधान mfn. careless, inadvertent.
अ-सावधान—ता f. carelessness.
